notes.title: Little Odyssey: Steam page launch!
notes.content:
Hello everybody! I am developing a new game, called [b]Little Odyssey![/b]
[previewyoutube=1U2ecm2U_iI;full][/previewyoutube]
The game is about traveling around fantasy desert on your giant turtle-giraffe and delivering packages from different settlements. 
If you want some relaxing journeys in your life, be sure to [b]add the game to your wishlist![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2434590/Little_Odyssey/

Thanks you, and take care :safeheart:
